workflows.title: Read Today’s balance and body trend · desktop
steps: Inspect the body trend, then open its full Progress section
checks: Balance distinguishes the stamped actual totals from the estimated end of day
Body renders both metrics and its Trend link opens Progress › Body

workflows.title: Log and edit a strength set, with rest across tabs · desktop
steps: Log the prefilled second working set
Extend rest, advance the clock ten seconds, and switch to Today
Return using the timer link, then Skip the rest
Tap the saved second set, change its reps to 8, and save
checks: A fresh backend read contains exactly two Bench press sets, with 8 reps on set 2
Rest extended from 1:30 to 2:00, reached 1:50 after ten seconds, survived navigation and cleared on Skip

workflows.title: Open exercise details from a session · desktop
steps: Open the exercise options and choose Exercise details
checks: Exercise details opened the matching catalog route with a strength progress chart

workflows.title: Append a planned slot beside existing intake · desktop
steps: Log the planned 07:15 slot and inspect the append confirmation
checks: A fresh backend read contains three additional food snapshots and one additional logged meal
The planned slot remains visible and can be logged again

workflows.title: Move a planned food into an existing time slot · desktop
steps: Use Banana’s row menu to move it into the existing 12:30 slot
Save the plan and inspect the mixed lunch slot on its detail page
checks: Backend confirms the shared lunch time and positions, with Banana still at 120 g

workflows.title: Edit a meal used by a nutrition plan · desktop
steps: Open the current ingredient’s food picker, then close it without changing the food
Change the ingredient amount and inspect the recalculated live totals
Save the meal without changing its plan reference
checks: The editor named the referencing plan and disabled Delete
A fresh backend read confirms 70 g of oats and all three ingredients

workflows.title: Open Calories from Progress Overview · desktop
steps: Follow See all energy to compare consumed and net calories
Switch the Calories period to 90 days without changing the energy-out period
checks: Progress lands on Overview and its Energy link opens both populated Calories charts
Changing Calories to 90 days left the energy-out trend on 30 days

workflows.title: Create, edit and delete a journal entry · desktop
steps: Write a Markdown journal entry and save it
Edit the entry and save the changed title
Open the editor, confirm Delete, and return to the journal list
checks: The create form navigated to a detail route and a fresh backend read confirms its title
A fresh backend read confirms the edited title
A fresh backend read confirms deletion and the deleted detail is no longer displayed

workflows.title: Change appearance and return to Today · desktop
steps: Select Light, inspect Today, then restore Dark
checks: The real theme control changed the document appearance and persisted across navigation
